# rsLoftCurvesPairs · Loft Curve Pairs

> Module: Geometry / Surfaces

[← Back to command index](/en/commands/)

**Function**: Surfaces (Brep) generated by lofting adjacent curves in pairs, each pair of adjacent curves generates a loft

**Run**: Enter `rsLoftCurvesPairs` in the Rhino command line (command-line interaction).

**Workflow**:

1. Command line input rsLoftCurvesPairs
2. Select at least two curves (in order of selection)
3. Automatically loft adjacent curves in pairs
4. Generate lofted surface

**Parameters**:

> This command has no numeric command-line parameters. Adjust its options in the settings window.

**Notes**: Loft in pairs in the order of selection (LoftType.Normal, closed=false); at least 2 curves required; no adjustable parameters.
